_status: v1.1 (Tomás, round 4). 60 white rum / 22.5 lime / 20 cherry-tomato-and-vanilla syrup, shaken, coupe, one cherry tomato on the rim where a strawberry would sit. Syrup = the Codex's Blended Strawberry Syrup method (p. 47: equal weights fruit and sugar, blended cold, sieved) with cherry tomatoes in the strawberry's place, plus a split vanilla pod overnight. Matrix: vanilla's surprise pairing is tomato (pdf 256); strawberries are tomato's listed substitute (pdf 244). Syrup, not juice: Codex p. 218; juice versions ran OUT (~12%). Tomato values are unsourced standard values (flagged).
